context_requirements: Functional P-glycoprotein (ABCB1) expression; most of these lines have low baseline ABCB1
A P-gp substrate drug co-administered to create a transport-dependent phenotype
No intrinsic transcriptional program driven by ABCB1/ABCB4 inhibition alone
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h after 10 µM P-gp inhibitor alone in any of the nine lines
Consistent upregulation of ABCB1 or ABCB4 mRNA as a compensatory response
Induction of a generic stress, apoptosis, or proliferation program by the inhibitor alone

evidence.supports: P-gp inhibitor tariquidar reverses chemoresistance and causes G2-M arrest only in combination with paclitaxel in P-gp-overexpressing ovarian cancer lines
P-gp inhibitor reversin 121 sensitizes MDR cells to doxorubicin; effects require a co-administered cytostatic
PSC833 increases doxorubicin cytotoxicity in MDR breast cancer cells but does not itself suppress growth
P-gp inhibitor encequidar synergizes with paclitaxel to induce apoptosis in resistant MCF-7/PTX cells
Tariquidar alters pigmentation gene expression in zebrafish larvae, a non-mammalian developmental context
